brokerSupportSummary: 1 verified adaptation · Tiger Paper. 5 pre-adapted connectors · account acceptance pending. Live execution is not enabled.
researchLibraryHelp: Recent opportunities and early leads, with separate evidence and status. More records do not mean more approved trades.
researchLibraryLeadOnly: Unapproved lead · inspect its source evidence
researchLibraryUnderReview: Current hypothesis · approval is a separate decision
researchLibraryHistorical: Saved research · not a current trade signal
researchLibraryEmpty: No saved records match this view. Expand the time scope or inspect Activity & history.
brokerConnectionsHelp: Configure and verify six provider connections. These isolated profiles do not replace the current Tiger Paper executor or enable autonomous live trading.
brokerInstallRequired: Install the optional broker runtime: uv sync --frozen --all-extras --project alta-runtime/broker-python. Then reload connections.
brokerConnectionUnavailable: The connection could not be confirmed. Check the account, credentials and required local gateway. No orders were sent; saved credentials are never read back.
brokerConnectionConflict: The saved profile or account authority changed. Reload before trying again. Account migration requires reconciliation.
brokerConnectionSaved: Saved privately. Trading remains disabled until separately verified and authorized.
brokerExactAccount: Exact account ID · Alpaca uses the account UUID
brokerIdentityUnconfirmed: Connected data · account identity not proven
brokerVerificationNotTrading: This read-only check does not authorize or prove order execution.
brokerAuth_rsa: Tiger ID, registered RSA private key and exact account. The existing Tiger Paper configuration remains separate.
brokerAuth_key_pair: Use environment-specific Alpaca credentials and the account UUID. Paper and live use separate endpoints.
brokerAuth_tws_gateway: Start and sign in to TWS or IB Gateway locally. Enable API access, use a nonzero client ID and an explicit account.
brokerAuth_opend: Start and sign in to OpenD locally. Specify the security firm, port and account. A live trade unlock password is not an API token.
brokerAuth_account_token: Longport app credentials connect to the trade SDK. Current balance responses do not prove Paper/live identity, so authorization remains blocked.
brokerAuth_oauth: Use a valid Schwab OAuth access token and account hash from your approved app. Tokens expire; browser authorization and renewal are not automated here. No Paper endpoint is offered.
noBoundCommitteeRuns: No reviewer run is linked to this opportunity in the current snapshot.
deskLastDay: Last 24 hours · active runs always included
executionModeHelp: Choose where approved decisions are executed. Simulation and brokerage authority stay separate.
shadowSimulationHelp: ALTA simulates fills, costs, positions, monitoring and exits in its durable local ledger. No brokerage orders are sent.
brokerApiHelp: Approved stock and ETF plans use the bound Tiger Paper account. Balances, positions, order tracking and recovery come from the broker. This route does not accept a live account.
executionStopFirst: Stop research before changing execution mode or credentials. Existing broker positions must be reconciled before switching back.
executionConflict: The account or authorization changed. Refresh and review before trying again.
executionUnconfirmed: The change could not be confirmed. Refresh the saved state before retrying; no retry is sent automatically.
brokerCredentialsHelp: Credentials are write-only and stored outside the repository. Saving never grants trading authority. Verify the connection before enabling Broker API mode.
brokerPrivateKeyHelp: Paste the PKCS#8 Base64 value from the Tiger configuration file. The key is never read back.
brokerEnvironmentOverride: An explicit environment configuration controls this account. Remove that override before replacing credentials from the console.
brokerAccountChangeBlocked: Switching accounts requires a recent verified empty account with no open orders. Refresh the broker snapshot first.
brokerInputInvalid: Check the Tiger ID, 17-digit Paper account and RSA PKCS#8 private key. Stored credentials were not changed.
fieldDescription: Follow each opportunity from its first signal to an audited decision.
ledgerDescription: Search decisions, inspect evidence, and replay what happened.
overviewDescription: Check service health, data availability, and research performance.
agentsDescription: Follow parallel research, independent reviews and the handoffs between them.

deskExpressionRole: Turn an eligible idea into a plan → risk audit
deskAuditRole: Check the plan and constraints → approve or wait
deskOtherRole: Inspect the run for its assignment and recorded outputs.
shadowDescription: Track simulated positions and outcomes. These are not broker fills.
capitalDescription: Manage Tiger Paper authorization, verified positions, and orders. Never live trading.
credentialsDescription: Configure providers and see which connections need attention. Keys stay private.

searchCommand: Search for a command to run…

recoveryOnlyAuthorizationDetail: New BUY orders are blocked. ALTA may only SELL the bound Paper position while it returns the account to an empty state.
paperRecoveryRequired: Paper recovery is still in progress
paperRecoveryRequiredDetail: A position or open order prevented immediate revocation. Authorization remains narrowly enabled for SELL-only recovery; verify the account and revoke again after it is empty.
capitalGateDetail: Execution authority is persisted by the backend. Revocation stops new entries; unresolved positions remain in recovery.
capitalRuntimeStopRequired: Stop the runtime before enabling so account identity and emptiness can be proven atomically.
capitalConfigRequired: Use Configure Tiger credentials above before requesting broker authorization.

noCapitalAudit: No capital authorization events have been recorded.
confirmPaperAuthorizationDetail: ALTA will perform a fresh broker verification and authorize only an exact 17-digit Paper account with no positions or open orders. Agents propose the opportunity and risk size; portfolio, liquidity, broker-capacity, preview, and notional gates retain final authority over whole-share DAY limit orders during regular hours.
confirmRevokeDetail: ALTA first verifies the bound Paper account. If exposure remains, it enters SELL-only recovery and keeps authorization narrowly active until the account is empty; only then is authorization fully revoked and the runtime stopped.
paperCapitalBoundaryDetail: No live-account route exists. Account numbers, configuration paths, private keys, and raw broker order IDs never reach this browser.
refreshCapitalHelp: This is an explicit read from Tiger Paper and is not part of the 2.5-second console polling loop.

reconnectingLocalService: Reconnecting to the local operator service

restoringConnection: ALTA is restoring the live connection.
